primary_population: AA; A sensitivity; full dated death, public figure, Gregorian birth >=1600, no alternative birth record, valid UTC Julian day
primary_estimand: first-attempt valid, non-identified; ordinal long=1, short=-1, balanced=0; insufficient missing, never zero; person mean over repeated calls; age-order concordance within sex and 50-year birth cohort; paired true versus shuffled
controls: fixed chart derangement within sex and 50-year birth cohort; uniform/constant score concordance .5; calibration-only cohort/sex mean lifespan; no label leakage
repeat_statistics: Within-person SD; stratified person-cluster influence bootstrap 2000 percentile 95% CI for pairwise concordance and paired difference; explicit linearization approximation; effective N counts distinct people, not answers
multiple_testing: One-sided within-cohort person-level label permutation 2000, +1 correction; Holm correction over 18 declared model associations; effect and CIs primary, no cherry-picked winners
source_limits: C-initial convenience cohort is not population representative
AA is source publisher rating, not independent certificate verification
event completeness and death-only survivor selection bias
anonymous charts still may be memorized
ancient texts do not specify modern age bins or probabilities; these are declared extrapolations
model versions in one family are correlated, not 24 independent confirmations

retry.invalid_outputs: preserve original, frozen same-prompt retry; primary first attempt only

qualification_gate: first 3 evaluation people, both arms, repetition 1; exact task IDs retained; schema complete >=2 of 6, no accuracy gate
plan: full eligible held-out cohort, no downsampling based on model results
unavailable_reason: v2 actual complete calls repeatedly reached Chat HTTP500; no silent fallback, no new requests for these routes
operation: Ancient qualitative life tendency is assessed against continuous observed lifespan ordering; no arbitrary age threshold or death-probability formula attributed to classics.

sensitivity.time_boundary: exclude charts within 5 min of a two-hour branch boundary
sensitivity.external_cause_limit: Only explicitly coded causes excluded; unspecified is not certified natural death

judge.prespecified_order: SHA256(review:personID), AA evaluation only; all 3 first-attempt true-chart answers; structural audit, no outcome labels
